housing.summary: Numbeo reports a September 2026 average of QAR 7,138.46 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Doha city centre; Qatar Living describes itself as the country’s largest property platform for rentals. A deposit norm was not grounded.

banking.summary: QNB offers digital onboarding to adult Qatar residents with a postpaid Qatari mobile number.
required_docs: Valid QID or passport for expatriates
Proof of address through the National Address in Metrash2

schools.summary: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education private-school search lists multiple curricula available in Qatar.

legal_admin.summary: Applicants seeking a residence permit must visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar for the required medical examination.
legal_admin.registration_step: Complete the Ministry of Public Health medical examination for residence-permit issuance at the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entry.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who is a taxpayer because they engage in business activity or earn taxable income registers through the General Tax Authority’s Dhareeba portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number.

transport.summary: Qatar Rail identifies the Doha Metro and Lusail Tram as its passenger network and confirms a 30-day monthly pass, but the official fares policy opened did not state the monthly price. PHCC health-card registration is available through the Nar’aakom app to residents aged 18 or over with a valid QID and Tawtheeq account; the card is collected at the designated health centre after paying QAR 100. https://www.phcc.gov.qa/patients-clients/eservice-guestpage/register-new-health-card
transport.healthcare_registration: Request a new health card through the PHCC Nar’aakom app using a Tawtheeq account and a QID valid for at least one year, then collect it at the designated health centre and pay QAR 100. https://www.phcc.gov.qa/patients-clients/eservice-guestpage/register-new-health-card
